steps.text: Open the Alignable sign-in page. The account for {login_email} already exists: never use 'Get Started Free' or 'Sign Up' (that makes a duplicate signup).
If the browser session is already signed in, Alignable redirects straight to /onboarding/verify (seen in the NM Chrome profile): go to the last step.

If signed out: type {login_email} in the email box (#biz_user_email). If a CAPTCHA shows, STOP and report needs-human (session expired). Otherwise click 'Next' (#submit). If the next screen offers the vault item {vault_item}, fill from it with the vault helper; otherwise choose the site's own 'email me a login link' option and open the link from the NM relay mail. Never print the link. Signed-out path past 'Next' not walked yet.
After sign-in Alignable lands on /onboarding/verify ('Verify your identity by entering your mobile phone number'). If it lands elsewhere, open https://www.alignable.com/onboarding/verify.
On /onboarding/verify, type {phone} in the phone_number field and click 'Verify with SMS/Text'. The account already exists, so this is only the phone-verify send.
